evidence: Pinned. The three runs of this judge and the three of the unfenced judge were fed the stored evidence of one reference run, because normal retrieval is not a fixed input: the keyword channel's statistics cover every run in the database, so a run's evidence depends on what else the database holds. A fresh ingest retrieves other evidence and need not reproduce this number.
noise_floor: 33, 33 and 32 of 37 over three runs on identical evidence (98 of 111); the unfenced judge scored 31, 29 and 32 (92 of 111) on the same evidence the same day; treat |delta| <= 0.03 as noise
note: Baseline of the fenced judge (the prompt-fencing PR: each excerpt its own plain-text document, the claim stated before the documents and again in the question, an untrusted-content policy in the system prompt). Supersedes the 2026-08-12 baseline of the unfenced judge (0.838, 31/37, no judge stamp, ordinary retrieval). All misses are under-commitment (SUPPORTED or CONTRADICTED judged UNVERIFIABLE), three of them the report's attributed claims in every run; no SUPPORTED/CONTRADICTED mix-up in any run. Not re-measured at the PR's final measurement (2026-10-12): a fresh ingest judged once by this judge stored nothing, because two answers looped to the output cap and one retry looped too. Read from that batch's raw answers, 28 of the 35 usable ones are right and both cut-off answers begin with the right verdict (30 of 37; unofficial: no quote check). The owner decided not to pay for a re-run.
